learnings.title: GitHub changelog: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves query accuracy, drops CWE-730 tag from regex queries, and skips pack files outside the root
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog page 2026-11-04-codeql-2-27-4-improves-accuracy-and-query-metadata (feed pubDate Wed, 04 Nov 2026 20:04:52 +0000; read 2026-11-06) states CodeQL 2.27.4 adds query accuracy improvements (java/log-injection recognizes more sanitizers; fewer Rust false positives; C/C++ pointer-scaling and unused-variable queries no longer flag std::byte* arithmetic or [[maybe_unused]] variables), stops applying the CWE-730 tag to the redos and regex-injection queries across C#, Java/Kotlin, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby and Swift, sends JVM warnings and initialization errors to standard error so JSON output stays clean, and on bundle or publish of a pack omits files that resolve via symbolic links outside the pack root with a warning. GitHub deploys it automatically to code scanning on github.com; GHES 3.24 will include it and older GHES must upgrade CodeQL manually.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: relevant only if the system plan runs CodeQL code scanning or publishes CodeQL packs (alerts tagged CWE-730 may change); no code or operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-11-13 whether any system repo uses CodeQL code scanning or CodeQL pack publishing that this release affects.

learnings.title: Shopify changelog: network_access_testing dev store feature preview tests app network_access settings
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog entry 'Test app network access configuration on dev stores' (feed pubDate Wed, 04 Nov 2026 18:00:00 +0000; read 2026-11-06) states dev stores created with the network_access_testing feature preview let apps test their [network_access] settings: links to hosts not in allowed_navigation_hosts show the exit warning, and the browser console warns when a storefront page loads from or sends requests to a server not in allowed_sources. The preview only warns and blocks nothing. Any app whose code links to or contacts external servers from a storefront can use it, and Shopify recommends all such apps configure these settings to avoid navigation warnings on merchant sites.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: applies only if the video_shopify plan ships an app or extension that links to or calls external servers from a storefront; no change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-11-13 whether any Shopify app in the video_shopify plan loads external resources on storefront pages and needs [network_access] configured.
